title: Chasing Daylight Podcast - QUAD Tour NT
body_html:
In collaboration with the Chasing Daylight Podcast, Garsen has created a custom QUAD Tour NonTapered grip. A base yellow grip with a black stripe on the face debossed with the Chasing Daylight Podcast logo embodies the colors and feel of the podcasts signature brand. 

A GOLF PODCAST WITH REAL TALK, FROM REAL GOLFERS

Broadcasting from Las Vegas, The Chasing Daylight Podcast is your weekly fix for everything golf. Hosted by four amateurs who are as obsessed with the game as you are, we cut through the noise to bring you:

  • Insider Access: Interviews with industry pros, from course architects to tour insiders.
  • Gear Talk: Honest reviews on the latest clubs and tech hitting the shelves.
  • Unfiltered Banter: The Majors, the mergers, and the current state of golf—debated without the filter.
  • Giveys: We love giving away things during our live shows on YouTube

Whether you’re a gearhead, a tour junkie, a seasoned golfer, or a newbie, pull up a chair. This is real talk from real people who play the game.

https://chasingdaylightpodcast.com/

title: Uneekscraper Grip Tape Remover Tool For Graphite Shafts
body_html:
The Uneeskscraper

The Uneekscraper will not damage, scratch or mark graphite or steel shafts.  It is significantly quicker than peeling off the old tape by hand and doesn’t require the use of a vise. Difficult to remove tape or clubs with tape build up may require several passes or a heat gun for easier tape removal.

The cutting blade is made from a toughen fiber composite that is very durable and can be re-sharpened using a belt a sander by following the original contour.  It will also remove lead tape and Mylar tags that are attached to new golf equipment.

title: Brampton HF-100 Golf Grip Tape Solvent Non-Toxic & Non-Flammable
body_html:
Unlike most harmful solvents on the market, HF-100 was created as a non-toxic, non-flammable, & odorless solution specifically design to be used for golf club re-gripping. When used correctly, HF-100 uses 60% less volume than standard solvents and also has a slower evaporation time so you can ensure your grips are lined up and installed correctly. 

Features:
-Non-toxic
-Non-flammable
-Odorless
-Effective with all standard grip tapes
-Reusable
-Easy clean up
-Economical - uses half the normal amount to install a grip
